nodes.text: If starting in Midnight’s Quel’Thalas, speak to Zidormi at the Eastern Plaguelands border and ask for the Burning Crusade timeline. Reach old Isle of Quel’Danas; the Shattrath central-chamber portal is an alternative approach when it actually reaches the legacy island.

recovery.text: Check that the world map is old Isle of Quel’Danas (122), not Midnight’s map (2424). The revamped Magisters’ Terrace has different bosses and is not this toy route. A transport must remain player-selected.

nodes.text: Select Heroic dungeon difficulty yourself and enter old Magisters’ Terrace at the northeast of the old island. Check that the dungeon contains Selin Fireheart rather than Midnight’s Arcanotron.

recovery.text: Recheck the named room, selected difficulty and current game objectives. Continue advances only the guide cursor; it never records a kill, unlock, purchase or ownership.

nodes.text: Clear the opening terrace to Selin Fireheart. Defeat him and loot his corpse; destroy a crystal he drains if the fight requires it. The Orb may already drop here.

recovery.text: Recheck the named room, selected difficulty and current game objectives. Continue advances only the guide cursor; it never records a kill, unlock, purchase or ownership.

nodes.text: Continue along the terrace passage to Vexallus. Handle the Pure Energy adds while defeating him, then loot his corpse for another Orb opportunity.

recovery.text: Recheck the named room, selected difficulty and current game objectives. Continue advances only the guide cursor; it never records a kill, unlock, purchase or ownership.

nodes.text: Proceed into Priestess Delrissa’s courtyard. Defeat her and her four companions, interrupting their healing where possible, then loot Delrissa.

recovery.text: Recheck the named room, selected difficulty and current game objectives. Continue advances only the guide cursor; it never records a kill, unlock, purchase or ownership.

nodes.text: Follow the remaining hall to Kael’thas Sunstrider. Defeat him through Gravity Lapse if it occurs, avoiding the floating orbs, and loot for the final Orb opportunity.

recovery.text: All four bosses are sources on Heroic. No drop means the goal remains open; the Heroic dungeon’s observed daily reset governs another full opportunity set.

nodes.writtenDestination: Legacy Heroic Magisters’ Terrace: leave Priestess Delrissa’s courtyard by the remaining dungeon passage and follow it into Kael’thas’s final chamber.

nodes.text: Use Orb of the Sin’dorei from your bags to learn the toy.

recovery.text: Only Toy Box ownership finishes this goal. Loot, mail, an achievement and the guide cursor remain separate evidence.
